title: [2.8.0] Add prime/fill and pump battery change to virtual pump insulet omnipod
body:
Reporting bugs
--------------
- **Note the precise time the problem occurred** and describe the circumstances and steps that caused
  the problem
- Note the Build version (found in the About dialog in the app, when pressing the three dots in the
  upper-right corner).
- Obtain the app's log files, which can be found on the phone in
  _/storage/emulated/0/Android/data/info.nightscout.androidaps/_
  See https://androidaps.readthedocs.io/en/latest/EN/Usage/Accessing-logfiles.html
- Open an issue at https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/issues/new

comments.body:
If pump has option to change battery, then virtual pump has this option. On omnipod you can't change the battery, so Virtual Pump doesn't support it either.
While Omnipod has Prime/Fill, that prime/fill is very specific to Omnipod, and its not done through AAPS default methods, which is why this is not enabled.

This ticket is therefore invalid, so it can be closed.
